channel.title: Off Road Xtreme - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Off Road Xtreme (offroadxtreme.com)

item.title: Peck Brothers Fire Up 200-Horsepower R1 Mini Trophy Truck
item.description: The Peck Brothers prove the impossible is possible. Their mini trophy truck drive system finally handles the screaming 200HP R1.

item.title: David Rule Converts A Cargo Trailer Into Luxury Camper For An Epic Eight-State Road Trip
item.description: David Rule turned a cargo trailer into a luxury camper for an eight-state road trip. The build features a custom interior and solar power.

item.title: 74 Weld Breaks Down Loren Healy’s El Bandito: A 1,000 Horsepower Super Bronco
item.description: El Bandito is a 1,000-horsepower Ford Bronco built for pure speed and stunts. 74 Weld breaks down the custom engineering behind this machine.

item.title: Back-Halved And Solid-Axled: A Beastly 2005 Chevy Silverado
item.description: This 2005 Chevy Silverado is back-halved, fit with a solid axle, and rolling on 43s. It has 6.0-liter power and big attitude.

item.title: Polaris Unleashes The RZR Pro R Ultra Edition, Raising the Bar For Factory-Built Desert Performance
item.description: Polaris debuts the limited-edition RZR Pro R Ultra with race-proven DYNAMIX DVS suspension active sway bar technology.

item.title: Tinkerer’s Adventure Builds The Ultra Toyota Tundra Rock Warrior For Insane Crawling
item.description: Tinkerer's Adventure reveals a unique Tundra for rock crawling build based on the rare Regular Cab Short Bed platform and other OEM parts.

item.title: When Thunder Meets Tradition: Monster Jam, Punxsutawney Phil, And The Most Unlikely Crossover Of The Year
item.description: When Monster Jam meets Groundhog Day, tradition gets a jolt of horsepower as Punxsutawney Phil inspires one of the most unexpected crossovers.

item.title: This Enviable 1970 Ford F-250 Hides A 625-HP 7.3-liter Godzilla And Roadster Shop RS4 Chassis
item.description: This 1970 Ford F-250 4x4 is a one-of-a-kind envy inducer. It sits on a Roadster Shop RS4 chassis, has a Godzilla V8, coilovers, and more.

item.title: Fifty Years Of BFGoodrich Radial All-Terrain: The Tire That Invented A Category
item.description: Celebrating 50 years of BFGoodrich Radial All-Terrain tires, from the original 1976 T/A to today’s KO3, and all that shaped the category.

item.title: Why Lifted Jeep Wrangler And Gladiator Driveshafts Fail—And How To Prevent Becoming A Victim
item.description: Why lifted Jeep Wrangler and Gladiator builds need upgraded Spicer performance driveshafts to driveline failure and lost trail reliability.
